# h3_ovn_eip (Resource)

**Deprecated:** use `h3_eip`; this alias is removed in 1.0. Manages an Elastic IP (public IPv4 address) of the project. `vm_id` attaches it to a VM and is changed in place; the address stays while the EIP exists, so a VM can be recreated without changing its public IP. Import by EIP ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) EIP name

### Optional

- `description` (String) Comment shown in the console next to the address (one line, up to 255 characters, no control characters). Changed in place; removing it clears the comment.
- `network_id` (String) Network ID (subnet ID)
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID). Defaults to the provider `project_id` (`H3_PROJECT_ID`). Changing it replaces the EIP.
- `vm_id` (String) Attached VM ID (use for attach/detach). Leave unset when the EIP is selected by `h3_vm.eip_id`: an attachment made outside this attribute is then not treated as drift (see `bound_resource_id`).

### Read-Only

- `bound` (Boolean) True when the EIP is attached or reserved by a resource being created; only unbound EIPs can be selected via `h3_vm.eip_id`. Null on backends that do not report it.
- `bound_resource_id` (String) ID of the resource the EIP is bound to, when bound.
- `bound_resource_type` (String) Type of the resource the EIP is bound to (`vm`, `db`, `lb`), when bound.
- `gateway_name` (String) Gateway name in the platform
- `id` (String) EIP ID
- `ip_address` (String) Allocated public IP address
- `status` (String) EIP status (DETACHED, ATTACHED, PENDING, ERROR)
